hero.label: The creative canvas where intelligence converges
hero.title: Let creation keep pace with thought.
hero.lead: Cluega is a boundless, free-form canvas. Here, frontier AI models, layer control, and team collaboration blend seamlessly into one. From concept generation and remixing variations to fine detail refinement — it all happens in the same place.

b1.title: Boundless workspace
b1.body: Every asset laid out flat and in plain view — the end of folder hell where files go missing. Zoom out to take in the whole project at a glance, or zoom straight in to pixel-level detail in an instant.

b2.title: Switch freely across every modality
b2.body: On any single canvas node, switch seamlessly between image, video, and upscale models at any time — without breaking your creative flow or ever leaving the page.

b3.title: Real-time online collaboration
b3.body: Live teammate cursors, instant comment feedback, and parallel generation. You and your whole team spark ideas together, in sync, on the same creative surface.

techniques.title: Put proven visual workflows to work instantly
techniques.lead: Cluega Workflows are reusable production lines built by Cluega and top creators worldwide. Find a template that fits your project and run it directly, or open it in your canvas to fine-tune in one click.

stills.title: Visual Production at Scale
stills.lead: With structured workflows, you can run matrix-style batch generation across multiple products, compressing weeks of image production into minutes for rapid, high-quality output.

adDataCore.lead: Every time you generate an asset, the system retrieves viral hits and trending topics in real time behind the scenes — injecting “viral conversion logic” straight into your copy, assets, and videos.

chat.title: Describe your idea — leave the rest to Cluega.
chat.lead: Give the AI complex instructions directly in plain language. Cluega automatically plans the execution path, selects the best-fit model, and renders the result straight onto your canvas — no fiddly parameters to tweak.

modelLibrary.title: Every leading model in the world, orchestrated freely anytime, anywhere.
modelLibrary.lead: Say goodbye to juggling subscriptions across platforms. From image generation to motion editing, switch core models freely right on the canvas — keeping your creative flow in one seamless take.

howItWorks.title: From the first spark to the final shot.
howItWorks.lead: No fiddly steps, no long waits. Just type your idea straight onto the canvas and fine-tune whenever you like — Cluega handles the shot transitions and the finishing details for you.

s1.title: Start creating
s1.body: Sketch anywhere on the canvas. A description, a style reference image, or a local file — any of them can be your starting point.

s2.title: Refine freely
s2.body: Wire up nodes to restyle, edit locally, animate, or upscale. Every edit stays intuitive and visible, and you can redo it anytime.

s3.title: Export and collaborate
s3.body: Export the high-resolution final in one click; need to collaborate? Just share the canvas link so your team connects seamlessly in the same workspace.

videoPipeline.title: Let your idea auto-expand into a coherent storyboard.
videoPipeline.lead: Enter your creative concept and Cluega proactively organizes it into a logical visual storyline. From style setup and shot layout to the final cut, the whole production line lays out flat and in plain view — no heavy lifting required, just fine-tune on the canvas whenever you like.
videoPipeline.promptText: A 30-second minimalist ad showcasing smart noise-cancelling headphones. Set in a white, minimalist home space with soft natural light, emphasizing calm and premium texture.

editInPlace.title: Pinpoint precisely, reshape locally.
editInPlace.lead: Mark a control point at the exact spot you want to change, type your edit, and Cluega precisely regenerates just that region — right on the canvas, with no need to regenerate the whole image.

s1.title: Mark the spot to edit
s1.body: Click the exact area of the image you want to adjust.

s2.title: Type a specific instruction
s2.body: Describe your edit precisely in text — e.g. “add a brand logo” or “change the background to light gray-blue”.

s3.title: Finish the local regenerate
s3.body: Cluega regenerates in place at the chosen spot, keeping every other element of the image perfectly intact.

c43.heading: Models that understand your industry.

c44.body: A closed Plan-Act-Check-Reflect loop verifies OCR, geometry, and color, locates defects, and repairs them in place. Up to three passes.

c45.heading: Switch models. Keep everything.
